retainedP3Summaries.summary: Listing card title scale and intra-card spacing are smaller and tighter than source.
Article body copy is approximately 10% larger and opening paragraphs render as one continuous block.
Mobile menu Back uses a literal angle-bracket glyph and the item stack is slightly lower with tighter leading.
Desktop dropdown lacks the source's bounded panel treatment.
